sources.title: Ask HN: Anyone else spending hours on freelance invoice reconciliation?
sources.content: I spend 2-3 hours every month trying to match my invoices with bank transactions. My accountant charges extra for the cleanup. Looking for a tool that can do this automatically without importing everything into QuickBooks.

sources.title: Tired of manual payroll CSV exports every month
sources.content: Every month I export payroll from Gusto, then manually copy numbers into our accounting spreadsheet. There has to be a better way. We are a 12-person company.
